landing.title: Your project in one place: from handover through execution to closing.
landing.subtitle: Belin connects EPC companies and their subcontractors. Daily reports with photos, calculated progress, hourly work and change orders, all in one place.
landing.point1: The crew reports in under 30 seconds, one handed, on the roof.
landing.point2: The EPC sees progress live, without calls and spreadsheets.
landing.point3: The paperwork for billing and acceptance writes itself.
landing.signInSub: Enter your email address and we will send you a sign-in link.
landing.heroLaptopAlt: The EPC dashboard on a laptop
landing.heroPhoneAlt: The crew screen on a phone
landing.footer: Data in the EU, Frankfurt. Slovenian, German, English.
landing.dropTitle: Upload the plan. The project fills itself in.
landing.dropBody: Drop the K2 report into Belin. From it we read the address, the power, the modules, the roof areas and the material list. You only review and confirm.
landing.dropAside: No retyping from a PDF into a spreadsheet.
landing.dropShot: Reviewing the data read from the plan
landing.loopBody: The crew enters quantities, adds photos and submits. The weather attaches itself. On the other side the dashboard updates live, without a call.
landing.loopAside: One thumb, one hand, thirty seconds.
landing.loopShotCrew: The crew screen on a phone
landing.truthTitle: What actually happens, documented the moment it happens.
landing.truth1Body: Rain, an obstruction, an incident. One tap, one photo, the client knows at once.
landing.truth2Body: The six working day clock runs visibly. Without a response the sheet counts as approved, and both sides know that in advance.
landing.truth3Body: The material check on day one shows what is missing. While it is still cheap.
landing.paperBody: Completion report with every day, photo and check. Acceptance protocol with both signatures. Invoice assembled from the purchase order, the approved hours and the change orders.
landing.paperAside: All in the project language, ready for accounting.
landing.compliance1: A1 certificate and exemption certificate in one place, with a warning before they expire.
landing.compliance2: Reverse charge on the invoice, without manual correction.
landing.ctaBody: Upload the plan and see in minutes what it looks like.

po.regieClause: Day-work hours. The contractor records day-work on hour sheets in Belin. The client approves or rejects a submitted sheet within six days of submission, counting Monday to Saturday excluding {holidays}; the day of submission does not count. If the client does not respond within that period, the sheet is deemed approved. Approved hours are charged at the hourly rate in this order.

onboarding.lead: Three steps to the first report from site. The first one takes two minutes.
onboarding.step1Body: Upload the K2 plan and we read the address, capacity, roofs and material from it.
onboarding.step2Body: Once the project exists, you send the subcontractor a link. Belin is always free for them.
onboarding.step3Body: The subcontractor's crew reports from a phone in half a minute: progress, photos and headcount. You see it all at once.
onboarding.helpBody: We can set up the first project together with you. Write or call.
